title: Pressure Pad

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Emits a signal when something is on it

body:
"Activates an output of 10.0 when a player or object is standing on the pressure pad."

The Pressure Pad is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a signal when something depresses the pad.

Functionality

When placed, the Pressure Pad is a 4×4 object. It can be resized to be as small as 1×1, or as large as 10×10.

Whenever a player or object's bounding box intersects with the bounding box of the Pressure Pad, it will emit a signal of strength 10 from its output port. Otherwise, it emits no signal. Large accessories on a player, such as tails or backpacks, can result in the Pressure Pad incorrectly detecting a player as standing on it.
